method: Fresh single-branch depth-1 bare clone from GitHub, no local object sharing. Every canonical payload read from cloned Git blobs and verified against committed SHA-256/bytes; four authorized upload/cover references and journal state inspected. No model/browser cache or render used.
limits: Proves remote Git retrieval of source/catalog/media and authorization state; does not claim application install/render reproducibility, mobile/native presentation proof or actual platform publication. Final receipt commit is pushed separately; exact publication release identity remains unchanged.
